tldr: Venus through the 5th house brings focus to creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy.
body: Venus transiting the 5th house softens creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports creative output and playful risk: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or performing for validation.
advice: Receive and refine in the 5th house deliberately. Work with creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
